body.text: POLICY T-4 ACH returns (company policy; the NACHA re-presentment limit is unverified and labeled as such): R01 insufficient-funds returns may be re-presented once after 5 banking days. R05, R07 and R10 returns are authorization disputes: never re-present without new written authorization; suspend future debits and open a Member Services case. POLICY X-2 Estimated tax overpayments are applied against the next installment rather than refunded (company policy; IRS rule to be verified by the tax advisor). POLICY C-1 Period locks: only the Controller may unlock a period; corrections to a locked period are booked in the open period tagged with the original period. POLICY V-3 Vendor master changes require the AP Specialist (owner) and a callback to the number on file; bank-detail changes by email are never accepted.
